The Export button now works, and the fix is committed as `e757246` on `main`.

**Cause:** `OrdersPage.export()` existed, but `__init__` only registered the `refresh` button handler. Nothing registered `export`, so clicking it hit the "no handler, do nothing" branch.

**Fix:**
- `src/orders-web/orders_page.py`: register `self.export` as the `"export"` handler in `__init__`, next to `refresh`.
- `tests/test_orders_web.py`: added `test_export_button_writes_one_download`, which clicks the button and checks that one CSV download is produced with the expected contents. The existing export test called `export()` directly, which is why it missed this.

All 5 web tests pass. I didn't run the app itself, so the check is the unit test that clicks the button.

I left out the existing uncommitted `README.md` change and the untracked `notes/` directory, since they aren't part of this fix. The commit message has the Co-Authored-By line from your instructions.
